name: Architecture · migration waves (tall footer)
purpose: A component-by-wave grid in the shared state encoding: rows are components, columns are Today, W1, W2, W3 and Target, a wave badge marks where each component moves, and a side column lists the risks and dependencies for each wave. This tall-footer version adds a source line, so the grid starts at the top of the body and the legend moves under the risk notes.

source_advisory_slots.note: four-item state legend (legacy, coexisting, migrated, retired); the tall footer carries a source line
